body:
Browser consumers currently have to fetch and merge `.lino` catalogs and detect languages themselves. The existing translation runtime also reaches `node:fs` and `node:path` through its loader imports, preventing native browser use.

This adds `lino-i18n/browser` with `loadCatalogs(urls)`, `detectLanguage`, `resolveLanguage`, and the shared `createI18n` translation API.

## What

- Fetch catalogs concurrently, merge every locale root in URL order, and apply migration aliases after merging. Later values override earlier matching keys. Fetch options, including cancellation, can be forwarded; failures identify the URL and retain their cause.
- Resolve explicit preferences and navigator languages against supported catalogs, trying exact tags before parent tags, then the configured default or first available locale. Matching accepts case differences and underscores and also works without a navigator.
- Extract browser-safe text parsing and the shared runtime while preserving the main entry point's file loaders and React hook type defaults. Add browser TypeScript declarations and mark ES modules as side-effect-free for tree shaking.
- Add a runnable static example, regression tests, Chromium CI, bundling/tree-shaking checks, and TypeScript checks for browser and React consumers.
- Add a minor changeset for the automated release workflow.

## Reproduction and verification

Before this change, `import('lino-i18n/browser')` fails with `ERR_PACKAGE_PATH_NOT_EXPORTED`. The five new tests in `js/tests/browser.test.js` were run before implementation and reproduced that failure. They now cover deterministic catalog merging even when responses finish out of order, multiple locale roots, explicit migration keys, HTTP/parse/network errors, language resolution, and navigator fallbacks.

The Playwright test loads English and Russian catalogs from a static server, detects `ru-RU`, verifies plural translations and English key fallbacks, then switches to English without reloading. A second test bundles the public browser export, executes it in Chromium, and verifies that Node modules and unused exports are absent. Existing Node directory loading and subscriber notifications are also verified.

Local validation passed:

- `npm run check` (lint, formatting, duplication)
- `npm test` — 47 passed
- `bun test --timeout 30000` — 47 passed
- `deno test --no-check --allow-read --allow-write --allow-env --allow-run` — 47 passed
- `npm run test:browser` — 2 Chromium tests passed
- `npm run test:types`
- Syntax, file line limits, changeset checks, and `npm run pack:dry-run`
- Version-policy and secrets checks
- Playwright MCP verified both fetched catalogs and live English/Russian switching

CI passed for commit `f73aa48`: all 18 applicable checks succeeded, including Chromium and the Node/Bun/Deno matrix on Ubuntu, macOS, and Windows. [JavaScript workflow run](https://github.com/link-foundation/lino-i18n/actions/runs/37560634590).

## Browser example

Run `node examples/browser-usage/server.mjs` from `js/`, then open `http://127.0.0.1:4173/examples/browser-usage/`. The screenshot shows Russian translations with an English fallback:

![Browser example with Russian translations and English fallback](https://github.com/link-foundation/lino-i18n/blob/issue-21-4b476aef9842/js/examples/browser-usage/screenshot.png?raw=true)

Fixes #21
